import sys
from PySide6.QtWidgets import QApplication, QMainWindow, QLabel, QVBoxLayout, QWidget

class MainWindow(QMainWindow):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__()
        self.setWindowTitle('PySide6 Desktop Application')
        self.resize(800, 600)
        
        widget = QWidget()
        layout = QVBoxLayout()
        label = QLabel('Professional PySide6 Window')
        layout.addWidget(label)
        widget.setLayout(layout)
        self.setCentralWidget(widget)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app = QApplication(sys.argv)
    window = MainWindow()
    window.show()
    sys.exit(app.exec())

import wx

class MainFrame(wx.Frame):
    def __init__(self):
        super().__init__(parent=None, title='wxPython Native Application', size=(800, 600))
        panel = wx.Panel(self)
        sizer = wx.BoxSizer(wx.VERTICAL)
        text = wx.StaticText(panel, label='Native Desktop Widget Layout')
        sizer.Add(text, 0, wx.ALL | wx.CENTER, 10)
        panel.SetSizer(sizer)
        self.Show()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app = wx.App()
    frame = MainFrame()
    app.MainLoop()

import toga
from toga.style import Pack
from toga.style.pack import COLUMN, ROW

def build(app):
    box = toga.Box(style=Pack(direction=COLUMN))
    label = toga.Label('BeeWare Native Toga layout', style=Pack(padding=(0, 10)))
    box.add(label)
    return box

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app = toga.App('Toga Native App', 'org.beeware.toga', startup=build)
    # Note: normally started via app.main_loop()

from textual.app import App, ComposeResult
from textual.widgets import Header, Footer, Static

class TuiApp(App):
    BINDINGS = [('d', 'toggle_dark', 'Toggle dark mode')]
    def compose(self) -> ComposeResult:
        yield Header()
        yield Static('CSS-styled Textual Terminal UI')
        yield Footer()

if __name__ == '__main__':
    app = TuiApp()
    app.run()

import pygame
pygame.init()
screen = pygame.display.set_mode((800, 600))
clock = pygame.time.Clock()
running = True
while running:
    for event in pygame.event.get():
        if event.type == pygame.QUIT:
            running = False
    screen.fill((10, 10, 20))
    pygame.display.flip()
    clock.tick(60)
pygame.quit()

import gi
gi.require_version('Gtk', '4.0')
from gi.repository import Gtk

def on_activate(app):
    win = Gtk.ApplicationWindow(application=app)
    win.set_title('GTK4 GNOME Native Application')
    win.set_default_size(800, 600)
    label = Gtk.Label(label='GTK4 Linux Widget Layout')
    win.set_child(label)
    win.present()

app = Gtk.Application(application_id='org.gnome.GTKApp')
app.connect('activate', on_activate)
# Note: normally ran via app.run([])

'''

    engine = QQmlApplicationEngine()
    engine.loadData(qml_data)
    sys.exit(app.exec())
